Search indexes lagged; the item below was announced on 9 November. dea.gov and the DOJ page returned 403 or empty to automated requests, so details come from search-result summaries of the release. stories.headline: About 120 kg of cocaine and a handgun found in a Long Island City high-rise apartment; two men face federal conspiracy charges
stories.summary: Announced on 9 November by the Southern District of New York and the DEA, the case centres on a Queens apartment leased by Glen Contreras where agents executed a search warrant.
